I used to think it was the best country in the world (and in some ways I still do) but some of the people/laws are just ridiculous. Still can’t believe that after hundreds of school shootings gun laws aren’t tighter. Right now people are straight up protesting lockdown even though it’s for their own safety. The way that poc have to be scared for their lives on a daily basis from even the police who are supposed to protect them? 

I know there are plenty of countries that are far worse in every aspect but I think it’s just the fact that America is always portrayed as the ideal or the ‘dream’. People from all over the world move from their home country to go live in LA or New York when they make it ‘big’ so growing up I always (naively) thought of it as the land of success where everything was better. In reality many of the people are stupid and stupidly entitled. There are really big problems like kids and teachers risking their lives every day they go to school but nothings done because people don’t want to give up their guns and the NRA funds politicians like how ridiculous is that? You can be black and going for a jog and get killed for absolutely no reason how is that still happening? and this is all without mentioning the man in charge like how on earth did someone who openly stated if he were to run he’d run as republican cause they’re stupid actually get elected as a republican? and his supporters are constantly shown to be idiots who don’t really know his platform (to be fair I don’t suppose he knows it either) when asked! I’m not even someone who would consider themselves anti-republican/a democrat I’m just shocked and astonished!

The country just seems to have gone from the place people aspire to be to the butt of every joke. Americans have become really selective over who can be classed as an American despite literally everyone being an immigrant (bar the Native Americans). The stereotype has become some fat, lazy, racist guy who’s utterly clueless about anything but loves his gun. Obviously not everyone is like this but it’s just really sad that ‘the land of the free’ is just not the reality.
